# Glossary {#sec-app-glossary .unnumbered}

::: {.callout-warning title="Status: stub — populated as chapters are drafted"}
:::

**AdmissionQueue.** Bounded MPMC queue used by sources, query starts
and query stops to inject tasks into the engine. Backpressure surface.
See @sec-solving-p2.

**Coordinator.** A separate process (Rust-implemented, currently
on the `ys-coordinator-integration` branch) that accepts queries,
runs the distributed planner, distributes per-worker subplans,
and coordinates lifecycle across workers. Chapter 19.

**DistributedLogicalPlan.** A `LogicalPlan` whose operators are
tagged with placement — which worker each operator belongs to.
Output of the distributed planner. See `nes-distributed/`.

**DistributedQuery.** Runtime representation of a query whose
operators run on multiple workers. See `nes-distributed/`.

**BIFOLD.** Berlin Institute for the Foundations of Learning and Data.
Hosts the joint research project under which NebulaStream is developed.

**BM.** BufferManager. Owns the pool of `TupleBuffer`s.

**Continuation.** A worker-thread strategy for handling a full task
queue without blocking, proposed in NebulaStream's design document but
superseded by the unbounded internal queue in the current
implementation. See @sec-solving-p1.

**DIMA.** Database Systems and Information Management group at TU
Berlin.

**Frontier.** In timely/differential dataflow, the lower bound of
timestamps that an operator may still receive. NebulaStream does not
use frontiers; see [Chapter 15](../chapters/15-two-queue-scheduler.qmd)
for context.

**ILP planner.** The integer-linear-programming-based component
that places operators across workers in a distributed deployment.
Lives in the distributed planner; consumes `NetworkTopology` and
`WorkerCatalog`; produces a `DistributedLogicalPlan`. Chapter 19.

**LHS / RHS.** Left- and right-hand side, used throughout the codebase
to label join inputs.

**MLIR.** Multi-Level Intermediate Representation. The IR family
NebulaStream's Nautilus JIT lowers to. Chapter 12.

**NetworkTopology.** The graph of workers and the connectivity
between them. Consumed by the distributed planner. See
`nes-distributed/include/NetworkTopology.hpp`.

**`nes-distributed`.** Module on `origin/main` holding the
distributed-plan abstractions, worker catalog, and network
topology graph. Chapter 19.

**`nes-network`.** Module on `origin/main` holding the
inter-worker data plane — Rust channels (`channel.rs`,
`memcom.rs`) with C++ FFI bindings. Chapter 19.

**Nautilus.** NebulaStream's tracing-based JIT framework. Chapter 12.

**OP.** Operator (logical or physical).

**OriginId / SequenceNumber / ChunkNumber / Watermark.** The four
progress identifiers used to reason about event-time progress and
window triggering. Chapter 7.

**PendingPipelineStop.** A polling task that checks whether a pipeline
still has references and re-emits itself if so. See
@sec-pending-pipeline-stop.

**SS.** StringStream. Used internally for log formatting.

**Systest.** A SQL-based end-to-end test in `nes-systests/`,
authored as a `.test` file. Chapter 20.

**TaskQueue.** The pair of internal-and-admission queues plus the
counting semaphore that synchronises them. Chapter 15.

**TB.** TupleBuffer. The unit of data movement in NebulaStream.
Chapter 3.

**TupleBuffer.** A reference-counted, fixed-size memory region holding
a batch of tuples. The unit of inter-operator data flow.

**WorkerCatalog.** The registry of available workers in a
distributed deployment, with their resources, capabilities, and
network reachability. Owned by the coordinator. See
`nes-distributed/include/WorkerCatalog.hpp`.
